problem_title: Recurring Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road — Hoodi (2019–2021)
problem_summary: 27 citizen complaints about 'Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road' were recorded in Hoodi between February 2019 and December 2021, spanning 3 calendar year(s). 52% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened). 1 complaint(s) were re-opened after initially being resolved.
representative_subcategory: Tarring Or Asphalting Of Existing Road

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

agency_attribution_note: 27 of 27 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier HIGH (score=0.66). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, complaint_volume=0.90, unresolved_rate=0.52.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Hoodi' not found in name crosswalk (one of the 15 unmatched wards). No enrichment applied.
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Hoodi for the period 2019–2021.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Investigate the 1 re-opened complaint(s) to determine whether patchwork repairs were applied and failed.
